name: qferry
description: QQ Mail organization tools for Codex with read-only and preview-first safety.

interface.shortDescription: Organize QQ Mail through safe, traceable mailbox tools.
interface.longDescription: QFerry exposes Gmail-like QQ Mail organization workflows to Codex. The initial plugin surface is read-only and preview-first: inspect bounded metadata, classify messages, create operation plans, and record trace artifacts before any real mailbox mutation is considered.
defaultPrompt: Use QFerry to inspect QQ Mail folders safely.
Classify a bounded mailbox sample into QFerry groups.
Create a preview-only cleanup plan with trace artifacts.
